dominant_strengths: Warm amber on deep charcoal palette feels editorial and intentional, escaping the cold-blue analytics cliché with embered warmth.
DM Serif Display hero number paired with DM Mono labels creates a credible editorial-meets-data typographic voice.
Sparkline with gradient fill and pulsing endpoint dot adds quiet craft and a sense of liveness to the card.
dominant_weaknesses: Card is jammed against the left edge and clipped, while raw markdown design notes dominate the canvas — the artifact reads as broken.
Header right-column ('Q1 20...') is truncated and overlapping, breaking the precision the typography promises.
Composition has no hierarchy at the page level: a single small card floats next to debug text, with no framing, grid, or breathing room.
fix_priorities: Remove the leaked design-spec prose from render and treat the canvas as the actual product surface.
Center or properly grid the card with generous margin; widen it so the Q1 2025 label and metrics breathe.
Tighten internal padding and align MRR/chart/footer to a consistent baseline so the precision claim is earned.
Add a second metric or comparative element to justify 'analytics' beyond a single hero number.
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral warmth carries it, but behavioral usability collapses under clipped layout and exposed source notes, leaving reflective intent unfulfilled.
rationale.intent_fit: Gestures at premium analytics through type and palette, but the broken composition and single metric fall short of an actual analytics surface.
